prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in St. Charles MO to sell my house?
competitors_mentioned: Jeremy Schneider of SCHNEIDER Real Estate
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable, objective “best” agent for every home—fit depends on your neighborhood, price range, and the agent’s recent **seller-side** results nearby.

A reasonable first person to interview is **Jeremy Schneider of SCHNEIDER Real Estate**. A Homes.com profile reports 21 seller transactions in the past year and 128 over five years, with sales across St. Charles and nearby communities. **Susan Brewer of Service 1st Homes** is another candidate; her Zillow profile reports a long St. Charles-area track record and substantial team sales. Those figures come from agent-profile sites, so verify them and ask how much of the work the named agent personally handles.

Before choosing, interview two or three agents and ask each for:
- Recent sales in your neighborhood and price range, including list-to-sale prices and days on market
- A suggested list price and the comparable sales behind it
- Their marketing plan, communication cadence, and who will handle showings and negotiations
- Their commission and any other fees, in writing

The best choice is the one who can explain a credible pricing strategy for **your specific house** and show relevant recent seller results—not simply the one with the biggest sales total.
